_about: Target: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507-FP8 (94 layers x 128 experts x 18.9 MB = ~227 GB of experts) on two PGX boxes. driver.py overrides store_dir (each box's local copy, /scratch/store/...) and the addresses.
_cache: Budget per box, ~120 GB usable: dense weights ~16 GB (stored in BF16; ~8 GB if attention stayed FP8), KV 4 sessions x 8k tokens ~6 GB, transient buffers ~0.6 GB, runtime ~9 GB -> ~85 GB of experts on paper; 85 was killed at engine start on the GB10 (120 GiB job limit, 2026-11-14), so 70. Keep the cache as large as fits: measure free memory on day one (README U9) and raise cache.gb as far as it goes; the job's memory request (memory in driver.py's SETTINGS) must stay above it.
